findings.summary: The original 1888 biography explicitly names Moses T. Glasgow and Martha W. (Thompson) as William Melancthon Glasgow’s parents. Each existing parent attachment receives its first individual 96% assessment; the birth date/place conflict remains open.

The 1909 obituary names Moses T. Glasgow and Martha W. (Thompson) as William’s parents and repeats the 1 July 1856 Northwood birth statement. It reports his death shortly after 1 p.m. on Tuesday, 2 March 1909, aged 52, at St. Timothy’s Hospital, Philadelphia. The retained profile’s 3 March death date is now an explicit conflict.

web_searches.result: The 1909 obituary names Moses T. Glasgow and Martha W. (Thompson) as William’s parents and repeats the 1 July 1856 Northwood birth statement. It reports his death shortly after 1 p.m. on Tuesday, 2 March 1909, aged 52, at St. Timothy’s Hospital, Philadelphia. The retained profile’s 3 March death date is now an explicit conflict. The original issue title and obituary page were visually inspected. This is a contemporary published death notice, not a civil death certificate. Its retrospective family and career wording closely parallels the 1888 biography, so independent testimony about the parents or birth is not established. The retained profile gives 5 July 1856 at Youngstown and death on 3 March 1909; the notice gives 1 July 1856 at Northwood and death on 2 March 1909. Both conflicts remain open. The existing father and mother assessments stay at 96%; no vital field, attachment or live flag changes.
